title: Imee, Robin push for PH to end cooperation with ICC, seek ex-President Duterte's return

blocks.text: Sens. Imee Marcos and Robin Padilla have filed a resolution urging the executive branch to end all cooperation with the International Criminal Court (ICC) and calling for the return of former President Rodrigo Duterte to the Philippines.
